contributions.claim: Saudi officials report three citizens killed and several others wounded in a Thursday Riyadh airport attack claimed by Houthis.
contributions.attribution: Saudi officials; Houthi claim via Guardian
contributions.uncertainty: Claimed responsibility does not independently prove perpetration.

contributions.claim: A later Guardian report describes a Houthi missile attack at Riyadh airport with dozens reportedly wounded; Saudi confirmation still awaited in this account.
contributions.uncertainty: Insufficient event timing to determine whether a second attack or revised account of Thursday attack.

contributions.claim: Trump says he is evaluating US participation in Saudi strikes on Houthis.

relations.reason: Same target and actor, but no explicit later-report event date; casualty wording and confirmation differ without proving correction or separate attack.

delta_expectations.reason: A materially distinct airport attack enters matter.
Reported casualty scale/confirmation status is material but identity must remain uncertain.
Policy consideration may be included as material related response.

ambiguity_notes: No forced correction between different casualty accounts; no forced second attack count. Repeated retaking claim does not resolve prior territorial dispute.
